Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
This is such an effortless, highly effective grill that has made my life easier!  Compact in design with a small footprint, the actual cooking surface proves to be more than ample with a handy upper grill for food that needs a little more indirect cooking. The large circular knobs mimic the iconic Wolf ovens with their little chunks of cherry red strip. The propane gas tank has an intelligently placed hook that holds it in place on the side and also gives an indicator of how much gas is left.  The grills are very nice and thick imparting excellent grill marks onto the food. I've used this several times and never fail to walk away with succulent, delicious tasting food for the family!  A definite winner and no-brainer for a top notch gas BBQ that will inspire you to fire up the grill more often.  I also decided to purchase the pricey grill cover that was made for this model, it is very easy to throw over (once completely cooled down of course) and has simple and effective velcro fasteners on the side to cinch in within seconds.  Worth the price.
After recently owning a now bankrupt company's electric/charcoal fusion BBQ, I am more than pleased with this Weber and will always come back to this brand.
Results.Title: The best Gas Grill you could ask for

With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
